title: Get back to your file.
label: HELP & CONTACT
introduction: A few checks solve most processing and download problems. Start with the situation that matches yours.
seoDescription: Help with FileCompresser: troubleshoot unsupported formats, large files, processing errors and downloads without sharing private files.

sections.heading: A file will not process
body: Check the accepted formats and per-file limit. Renaming an extension does not convert a file. Encrypted PDFs, detected signed PDFs and unsupported archive structures need a different workflow.

sections.heading: Processing is slow
body: Try fewer queued files, a shorter clip or a smaller resolution cap. Keep the tab open. Cancel a job before changing settings, then retry the input.

sections.heading: The result is larger
body: Already compressed files can have little room to shrink. Compare byte counts and review the output. A format conversion can legitimately increase size.

sections.heading: A download did not start
body: Try the individual Download button or a ZIP for several results. Check browser download permissions and device storage. Results stay in the tab until cleared or closed.

sections.heading: Document a problem without sharing private content.
body: Record the tool, input format and approximate size, browser version and exact error message. Keep confidential content out of screenshots. FileCompresser does not offer a file-submission form. Send a description of the issue to support rather than private files.

support.text: Choosing a format or quality setting?
support.emphasis: Find a practical answer in the file guides.
